title: Homology of one filtered-complex quotient page
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $K^\bullet$ an integer-indexed cochain complex, and $F$ a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. Let $r\ge1$ and let D be differential data as specified in [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential], on the concrete quotients $Q_r^{p,q}=Z_r^{p,q}/B_r^{p,q}$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. For every bidegree $(p,q)$ there is an isomorphism $H(D.\mathrm{page})^{p,q}\cong Q_{r+1}^{p,q}$. The next page differential is not assumed or constructed.

source.place: Tag 012K, displayed cycle, boundary and differential formulas and lemma-spectral-sequence-filtered-complex

proof.text: Successor graded cycles are contained in the current graded cycles: antitonicity of F.step passes through degreewise images, pullback, intersection, sum and graded image. This inclusion is proved directly in Lean.
Apply the successor-cycle cover to obtain an epimorphism f from Z_(r+1) onto the kernel of the outgoing page differential, with its restriction equation.
The inverse image under f of the incoming image in page cycles is exactly the inclusion of B_(r+1) in Z_(r+1).

Mathlib homologyIsCokernel identifies the kernel of the homology projection with the incoming image. Inverse image commutes with kernel, proved here from factorization criteria. Therefore the inclusion of B_(r+1) and f followed by the homology projection form an exact short complex. Both f and the homology projection are epic. Mathlib ShortComplex.Exact.gIsCokernel makes their composite a cokernel of that inclusion. Uniqueness of cokernels identifies its target with the constructed next page object.

proof_origin.place: H2: steps 1–2 split into representative calculations; step 3 proved using Mathlib homologyIsCokernel, exact_iff_image_eq_kernel, Exact.gIsCokernel and colimit uniqueness.

theorem filteredComplex_page_homology
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (D : FilteredComplexPageDifferential K F r) (pq : ℤ × ℤ) :
    Nonempty (D.page.homology pq ≅ filteredComplexPageObject K F (r + 1) pq)
